segments.t: 清晨的阳光倾泻进九号房敞开的绿色百叶窗。汉娜在一张小桌上铺开干净的厨房巾，泰莎和亚瑟则凑近那个蜡布包裹。请先完整听一遍这一幕。
Untie the string slowly, Hannah — thirty-year-old twine could snap in a second!
Beeswax on heavy linen really works; not one drop of dampness reached the inside.
Fold back the left flap, fold back the right flap... look at those bright colors!
Wait — I know that red-and-gold tin box! My aunt kept holiday almond biscuits in it!
Look at the strip of white cloth tape wrapped around the rim of the lid.
There are words written in faded black ink right across the top of the tin!
Pull down my glasses — no, here they are — let me read my family handwriting!
What does the label on the lid say, Arthur?
It says: Time Capsule of Room Eight and Room Nine, May, for a sunny morning.
They really left this box waiting for the week Room Nine opened again!
Try lifting the corner of the lid, Hannah — will it open by hand?
Not a millimeter; thirty years made this tin lid tight, so call Graham!
现在我们逐句回顾大家打开这只神秘包裹的时刻。
Untie the string slowly, Hannah — thirty-year-old twine could snap in a second!
“慢点儿解开绳子，汉娜——三十年的麻绳一眨眼就可能绷断！”反向前缀 un- 把 tie（“系，捆”）变成了它的反义动作：
Untie the string slowly
情态动词 could 在这里警示绳子随时可能突然崩断的风险：
could snap in a second
Beeswax on heavy linen really works; not one drop of dampness reached the inside.
“厚亚麻布上的蜂蜡确实管用；一丁点湿气都没有渗进里面。”用来强调某种方法在实践中真的有效，常说：
Beeswax on heavy linen really works
并用这个短语突出里面完全干燥：
not one drop of dampness
Fold back the left flap, fold back the right flap... look at those bright colors!
“向后翻开左边这片，再翻开右边这片……快看这些多鲜亮的颜色！”短语动词 fold back 意为“把布片或折翼向后翻折打开”：
Fold back the left flap
由此露出了鲜艳的图案：
look at those bright colors
Wait — I know that red-and-gold tin box! My aunt kept holiday almond biscuits in it!
“等等——我认得那个红底金边的铁皮盒子！我姑妈以前就用它装节日杏仁饼干！”用连字符连起来的复合颜色词，在名词前作单个定语修饰语：
that red-and-gold tin box
里面曾存放着：
holiday almond biscuits
Look at the strip of white cloth tape wrapped around the rim of the lid.
“看那条绕着盒盖边缘贴着的白色布胶带。”名词 strip 指布料或纸张裁成的窄长条：
the strip of white cloth tape
把盖子一圈封得严严实实：
around the rim of the lid
There are words written in faded black ink right across the top of the tin!
“盒盖正上方有用褪色的黑墨水写的字呢！”在英语中，“用某种墨水书写”固定搭配介词 in：
written in faded black ink
横贯盒盖顶部：
right across the top
Pull down my glasses — no, here they are — let me read my family handwriting!
“把我的眼镜拉下来——不，原来就在这儿呢——让我读读我们家的字迹！”亚瑟在自己额头上摸到眼镜时，脱口而出：
here they are
迫不及待想认出：
my family handwriting
What does the label on the lid say, Arthur?
“亚瑟，盒盖上的标签写的什么？”询问告示、便条或标签上写了什么文字，英语固定使用动词 say：
What does the label on the lid say
It says: Time Capsule of Room Eight and Room Nine, May, for a sunny morning.
“上面写着：‘八号房与九号房时间胶囊，五月，献给一个晴朗的清晨。’”回答时也沿用第三人称的 say：
It says: Time Capsule
并用介词 for 献给那个特定的早晨：
for a sunny morning
They really left this box waiting for the week Room Nine opened again!
“他们真的把这个盒子留在这里，一直等着九号房重新开放的这一周！”结构 leave something waiting 描写“把某物留在原地静静等待”：
left this box waiting
时间定语从句直接跟在 week 后面，无需再加关系副词 when：
the week Room Nine opened again
Try lifting the corner of the lid, Hannah — will it open by hand?
“汉娜，试着抬一下盒盖的角——用手能直接掰开吗？”动词 try 后面接动名词 -ing，表示“试一试看会怎样”：
Try lifting the corner
不带冠词的固定短语 by hand 意为“徒手，不用工具”：
by hand
Not a millimeter; thirty years made this tin lid tight, so call Graham!
“一毫米也掀不开；三十年把这铁皮盖子咬死卡紧了，快叫格雷厄姆来吧！”斩钉截铁的否定用：
Not a millimeter
后面接使役结构 make + 宾语 + 形容词：
made this tin lid tight
让我们从头到尾再听一遍整幕对话。
Untie the string slowly, Hannah — thirty-year-old twine could snap in a second!
Beeswax on heavy linen really works; not one drop of dampness reached the inside.
Fold back the left flap, fold back the right flap... look at those bright colors!
Wait — I know that red-and-gold tin box! My aunt kept holiday almond biscuits in it!
Look at the strip of white cloth tape wrapped around the rim of the lid.
There are words written in faded black ink right across the top of the tin!
Pull down my glasses — no, here they are — let me read my family handwriting!
What does the label on the lid say, Arthur?
It says: Time Capsule of Room Eight and Room Nine, May, for a sunny morning.
They really left this box waiting for the week Room Nine opened again!
Try lifting the corner of the lid, Hannah — will it open by hand?
Not a millimeter; thirty years made this tin lid tight, so call Graham!
蜡面亚麻布之下，一只红金相间的杏仁饼干铁盒闪闪发光，正等着格雷厄姆和那双沉稳灵巧的手。我们下一幕见！
See you next time!
